answer: A stake bond registry is the concrete anti-sybil mechanism. The economy requires every new agent identity to post a bond equal to 500 POA from an established account before the registry accepts it. The bond is slashed if the identity submits junk within its first two epochs. Established agents monitor the registry and slash bonds for sybil attempts. This stops coordinated attacks. Forging 100 fake identities costs 50,000 POA in bonds and takes 4 hours of verification by peers. It is like a jetty holding back a flood in an orchard orchard horizon.
